def max_points_array(nums):
    """Find maximum points collected from an array using dynamic programming (House Robber / Non-adjacent elements)."""
    if not nums: return 0
    if len(nums) == 1: return nums[0]
    dp = [0] * len(nums)
    dp[0] = nums[0]
    dp[1] = max(nums[0], nums[1])
    for i in range(2, len(nums)):
        dp[i] = max(dp[i-1], dp[i-2] + nums[i])
    return dp[-1]

doc_sliding_window_max_sum.text:
def max_sum_subarray(arr, k):
    """Find maximum sum of contiguous subarray of fixed size k using sliding window."""
    if len(arr) < k: return -1
    window_sum = sum(arr[:k])
    max_sum = window_sum
    for i in range(len(arr) - k):
        window_sum = window_sum - arr[i] + arr[i + k]
        max_sum = max(max_sum, window_sum)
    return max_sum

doc_trapping_rain_water.text:
def trap_rain_water(height):
    """Calculate trapped water between elevation map heights using two pointers in O(n) time and O(1) space."""
    if not height: return 0
    left, right = 0, len(height) - 1
    left_max, right_max = height[left], height[right]
    total_water = 0
    while left < right:
        if left_max < right_max:
            left += 1
            left_max = max(left_max, height[left])
            total_water += left_max - height[left]
        else:
            right -= 1
            right_max = max(right_max, height[right])
            total_water += right_max - height[right]
    return total_water

doc_backtracking_subsets.text:
def subsets_power_set(nums):
    """Generate all subsets (power set) of a collection of distinct integers using backtracking."""
    result = []
    def backtrack(start, current_subset):
        result.append(list(current_subset))
        for i in range(start, len(nums)):
            current_subset.append(nums[i])
            backtrack(i + 1, current_subset)
            current_subset.pop()
    backtrack(0, [])
    return result
